newsitem.title: GERMANY: German prosecutors say Graf to be jailed soon.
newsitem.headline: German prosecutors say Graf to be jailed soon.

text.p: German prosecutors on Tuesday said the father of tennis star Steffi Graf would go to jail within two months after his sentence for tax evasion was legally confirmed when prosecution and defence appeals against it were dropped.

Peter Graf was sentenced to three years and nine months in January after being convicted of evading and trying to evade 12 million marks ($6.9 million) in taxes on Steffi's earnings, but was freed pending the result of the appeals.
Prosecutors said they had withdrawn an appeal aimed at increasing the sentence handed down by the the Mannheim court, which they felt was too lenient.
They said Graf's defence lawyers had also dropped an appeal against the court's findings and the sentence was now legally binding.

Prosecutor Horst Kuehner told Reuters it would be six to eight weeks before Graf would have to go to prison because of legal formalities and he would remain free until then as long as he did not break any of the terms of his bail.
Kuehner said Graf would probably have to serve two thirds of his sentence in total, meaning he ay be in prison for around 15 months, because he has already served 15 months in investigative custody.
Prosecutors said they had dropped their appeal because they had found no legal errors in the court's written verdict.

Prosecutors in March dropped investigations against Steffi Graf herself, now recovering in a Vienna clinic after a knee operation, after she agreed to make a donation to charity. Media reports put the sum at 1.3 million marks. ($ = 1.731 German Marks)
